scope: One editable post with branch navigation, widgets and a native form through owned Mattermost 11.1 API/HTTP/WS and real Redis
scenario: issued slash command created one home post
orders and incidents both opened shared help and Back restored the actual source branch
pager and filter actions atomically replaced text and controls on the same post
a signed action opened a native form on the authenticated actor WebSocket
server-forwarded form submission edited the same post into confirmation
terminal replay returned the stored response without repeating the business effect
an independent Redis client restored the confirmation state and submitted value
local_regressions: outdated post actions are acknowledged and do not repeat navigation
FormWindow to FormWindow uses DialogSubmission.next and rotates managed form state
native cancel restores the window that opened the form
unrelated signed callbacks are left to subsequent Router handlers
cleanup: temporary slash command, one post and Redis keys removed
limits: This is API/HTTP/WebSocket evidence, not browser rendering evidence.
Desktop and mobile client acceptance remains part of E5-03.
